📖 Game script

Two 3–0 teams in a dome. Patrick Mahomes (237+) has Kenneth Walker III (87+ rushing, −181 to score), Rashee Rice (57+; PropStarz over 54.5) and Travis Kelce (48+). Las Vegas answers with Kirk Cousins (223+), Ashton Jeanty (58+, −136 to score) and Brock Bowers (74+; Grant Neiffer has him +200 to score). The Raiders are +5 in turnovers, and Maxx Crosby is Pat Fitzmaurice's reason to expect a slower Chiefs offense. Kansas City allows 16.7 points a game. Chiefs by three, so the Raiders cover +4.5; 47 points.

🧠 Why the card leans this way

LV: Sharp or Square (twice, "divisional home underdog"), Even Money (both hosts, best bet: Steve Fezzik and Ross Tucker), Pat Fitzmaurice, Simon Hunter, who already bet it, and Dave Tuley of VSiN (a best bet). KC: BettingPros (twice), Andrew Erickson, Derek Brown and Mike Florio (Chiefs 23–16). Splits: KC has 52% of tickets and 55% of the money on the spread, and the LV moneyline has 11% of tickets and 10% of the money, no gap. Evan Abrams' primer backs the Raiders: its home-dog-against-an-undefeated-team system is 101–66–4, and when two undefeated teams meet in Week 4 or later, the home team is 25–17–1 against the spread. The line moved toward the Raiders, from the Action Network open of KC −5.5 to −4.5. The lean is LV +4.5, with Bowers receiving as the prop. Total opinions lean under: Pat Fitzmaurice, Derek Brown and Steve Makinen of VSiN at 47.5 and Wes Reynolds at 48, against Fezzik (47.5) and BettingPros (46.5) on the over. With the projection at 47, that's a small under lean, not a bet. Card: the LV moneyline is in the Slot 2 Dog-ML 2-team RR (LV +4.5 is a SuperContest alternate), and Patrick Mahomes 2+ passing TDs is in the 7b Afternoon prop stack: a Chiefs win by 3 or less cashes both.

⚠️ What breaks it

Mahomes and Walker score early, Cousins has to chase, and the +5 turnover luck reverses: a Kansas City win by ten. If Walker gets the red-zone work BettingPros expects, the Chiefs cover by scoring touchdowns instead of field goals.
